newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rubber unchanged in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rubber unchanged in late trade.

text.p: Indonesian SIR20 offer prices remained unchanged in late trading on Monday on the back of sluggish demand, traders said.

"We still don't hear any fresh deals taking place today. Traders are reluctant to sell rubber in Palembang and I heard offer prices quoted at 46.00 U.S. cents/lb. It's just not profitable to sell at that level," said one trader.
Traders said offer prices were quoted at 46.75 fob Medan for May/June shipment, 46.25 fob Padang, 46.50 fob Surabaya, 46.00 fob Jambi and 45.75 fob Pontianak.
They said sentiment stayed poor because of sluggish demand.
